##### Project General Facts

Wasl 1 Residences epitomizes the perfect blend of urban sophistication and serene parkside living, with the breathtaking beauty of Zabeel Park unfolding before residents' eyes. This iconic development boasts a flawless fusion of modern design and premium amenities, crafting an extraordinary lifestyle that surpasses expectations. The dual tower complex of 1 Residences features three connecting levels, home to an array of exclusive facilities, including a state-of-the-art gym, a jogging track, and a stunning outdoor swimming pool with sunbathing areas, all designed to excite and amaze.

Life at 1 Residences is a symphony of elegance and refinement, with the interiors meticulously designed to make a lasting impression. From the elegant wood accents to the brushed stainless steel highlights and marble finishings, every detail is carefully crafted to maximize the everyday experience of residents. The residential units, ranging from one to three bedroom apartments, are styled to seamlessly connect with the vibrant surroundings, ensuring a lifestyle that befits this desirable destination. With porcelain tile floors, painted white walls and ceilings, and moisture-resistant gypsum ceilings, the finishes are truly exceptional.

The residences at 1 Residences are further enhanced by equipped kitchens, perfectly blending form and function to create a culinary haven. The absence of furnishing allows residents to personalize their space, making each home a unique reflection of their individuality. With its prime position alongside Zabeel Park, 1 Residences offers an unparalleled lifestyle, where residents can wake up to invigorating views, take a refreshing stroll, or play with friends and family, all while being just minutes away from the buzz of city life.


##### Location description and benefits

Dubai, a city of unparalleled excitement and opportunity, is home to the prestigious Wasl1 1 Residences. This vibrant and contemporary residential community is nestled in the heart of the city, offering residents unprecedented accessibility to the rest of Dubai. With easy pedestrian access to the metro station and transport lines, as well as Sheikh Zayed Road, residents can move around the city with ease, exploring all that Dubai has to offer. The community's strategic location, nestled between old and new Dubai, provides direct connections to key destinations and essential commercial locations.

Residents of Dubai enjoy a unique blend of traditional and modern attractions, from the historic landmarks to the cutting-edge entertainment venues. The city's world-class infrastructure, including its extensive transportation network, makes it an ideal location for both professionals and families. With its diverse range of amenities, including recreational facilities, retail outlets, schools, and mosques, Dubai offers a self-contained environment that emphasizes convenience and encourages a sense of belonging. From the stunning beaches to the majestic desert landscapes, Dubai's natural beauty is simply breathtaking, making it a truly unique and captivating city.

Dubai's architecture is a testament to its rich cultural heritage, with modern design concepts blending seamlessly with traditional elements. The city's meticulously planned neighborhoods, lush landscaped parks, and pedestrian-friendly walkways encourage outdoor activities and community engagement, creating a balanced and attractive living destination for residents. With its proximity to key landmarks and major roadways, Dubai ensures easy connectivity to the rest of the city, making it an ideal location for those who crave excitement, opportunity, and unparalleled quality of life.
